task_description: Public frontend only (Public/frontend-v6, the LIVE chhath.shaharpura.com SvelteKit app). Three UX fixes that must work in ALL skins: (1) show the contributor's profile photo in the Contributor Details card (with initials fallback), (2) make the details card open cleanly from the correct anchored position on tap, in every theme, and (3) make every right-to-left/horizontal contributor scroller live and identical across themes. No backend/API changes; scoped to Public/frontend-v6 only. Do NOT push or open a PR.
